issues.title: Button overlaps list content
issues.description: The floating jump-to-latest button obscures text in the activity feed item beneath it.
issues.evidence: The circular arrow button covers the end of the text on the lowest activity entry in the right sidebar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the activity feed container or position the floating control clear of text content.
issues.triageNote: Real occlusion with no built-in clearance affordance: added a backdrop-matched radial scrim to the component that fades content approaching the FAB (page-level bottom-lane padding remains a documented container contract since eval pages are off-limits).

issues.title: Activity item overlap
issues.description: The floating JumpToLatest pill overlays the latest activity log item, reducing readability.
issues.evidence: The 09:57 timestamp and text at the bottom of the activity list sit directly underneath the floating pill.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container to ensure the last item scrolls clear of the floating control.
issues.triageNote: Intended FAB-over-fade pattern, but the control cluster sat directly on live rows; the built-in scrim now fades the feed beneath the FAB into the rail background (full lane reservation is page-level, documented in meta/demo).
